name: Los Fayos (Spain)
description: Blue field with white dancetty stripes along the upper and lower edges bearing green trees, charged at the centre with a yellow castle.
history: Municipal flag of Los Fayos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
